Image alt: When constructing a Business Plan, ask the following questions: How can I manage and juggle the related operational and administrative responsibilities for the venture? How quickly (or slowly) should I grow the venture? Potential Obstacles include Limited experience or knowledge of the operational and administrative needs of a business, and Limited access to resources and a support system.
